issues.issue: The only supplementary schedule was left out of detail[] because it mixes fund types. The expenditure lines can be separated: the six governmental function lines add to exactly 900,137.15 (the governmental statement total), and Junkyard/Sewer/Water are business-type. Revenue and debt lines are mixed and could be recorded with fund 'All funds' and a review note. The extractor rules ask for every budget-to-actual line with actual and budget_final.
